display.summary: Inline updates and rollbacks take their pre-update backup again (lost in 1.10.0), plus backup-chain fixes found by break-testing 1.11.0b4.
highlights: Inline updates and rollbacks back up before Composer swaps the code; a failed backup stops the update. Takes effect for updates started from this release.
Rolling back below 1.11.0b4 no longer breaks deleting a backup chain's full backup.
Clearer, final errors when an incremental backup cannot continue its chain.
Starting two backups at the same moment can no longer create two.
Database migration: additive and inline-safe for 1.10.x installs (backup options and chain columns); none since 1.11.0b4.
